capabilities: Send notes or folders to reMarkable as typeset PDF or reflowing EPUB
Import pen marks as strikethrough, bold, underline, highlight, quotes and task states
Write annotations into a companion note or a marked block inside the source note
Round-trip editable text notebooks back into the note body
Track notes by a stable remarkable-id across moves and renames
disambiguation: Not a general vault sync tool; it sends individual notes to a reMarkable device and imports their pen marks back.
extras: The repository is a mirror of a private development repository, so pull requests cannot be merged directly. Images render as placeholders in the PDF, handwriting returns as an image rather than text, and the stroke reader works against an undocumented format.
motivation: The author wanted the best of both worlds: writing and editing in Markdown with a keyboard or dictation, then switching to reMarkable to slow down, review and think.
problem: Reviewing with a pen on reMarkable is comfortable, but the marks stay on the device instead of returning to the Markdown note they were made on.

relations.evidence: Self-hosting rmfakecloud instead? Toggle Self-hosted endpoint and give your base URL.

summary: Sends Markdown notes to a reMarkable tablet as PDF or EPUB and writes pen annotations back into the note they came from.
